_note: deco-lagoon album DRAFT (Nov 7): Claude's own picks, Tiffany's Nov 7 7:03pm ask ('You take them, just like you did this one'). Groups in order; 'lowres' = best photo we have is under ~800px.

mats.name: Jade
mats.why: A Tiles & Tablescapes member's pick, and yours: teal-green fans on a periwinkle and navy ground. Moody, and it carries her teal backs, navy dots and periwinkle stars.
mats.tnt: Heather Huddleston McDonough: Deco Lagoon on OMM Jade, BBB racks ("the moody, slightly masculine feel I was looking for")

mats.name: White Lotus
mats.why: Shown twice in Tiles & Tablescapes with Deco Lagoon: soft aqua and ivory with a gold key frame. Her gold palm and ivory faces, with a lighter teal around her.
mats.tnt: Nandi Linscombe Shenkan + Bernadette Yllana Gerace: Deco Lagoon on Mahj Tile Haus White Lotus

mats.name: Mahj In Bloom Mat
mats.why: A Tiles & Tablescapes member styled Deco Lagoon on it with Bam Bird's Mulberry racks: deep teal with lilac and pink roses. Soft berry on her teal.
mats.tnt: Jessica Green-Myrow: Mahj in Bloom styled three ways, tablescape 2 = Deco Lagoon + Bam Bird Mulberry racks

mats.name: YOTD Black
mats.why: From Tiles & Tablescapes: black with embroidered dragons and pink roses. Dragons like hers, and the teal, berry and rose in the stitching pick up her faces.
mats.tnt: Nandi Linscombe Shenkan: Bespoke Year of the Dragon (black) with Deco Lagoon, Club Mah Jenn Mother of Pearl racks

mats.name: Brightside
mats.why: From Tiles & Tablescapes: an aqua and green deco lattice. One of its teals matches her backs almost exactly, and it gives her a brighter, daytime look.
mats.tnt: Rhonda Lehtinen: Deco Lagoon on My Fair Mahjong Brightside (green); "one of the colors matches the deco almost perfectly"

mats.name: Reba
mats.why: Your favorite Deco pairing. The deep teal field holds her Lagoon backs, and the pink frame and bouquet pick up her mulberry and rose faces.

mats.name: Viola
mats.why: A deep teal center inside a black floral border of pinks and plums. Moody, and very her: her teal backs and her mulberry faces in one mat.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Mulberry)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's own Deco Dragon mat, in her sister color. Same deco lines and dragons as the tiles, and the mulberry plays off the teal instead of copying it.

mats.name: Eden
mats.why: A deep teal frame around a garden of blues, pinks and corals; the pond in the middle picks up her periwinkle stars.

mats.name: Pretty in Plum Premium
mats.why: Plum, lilac and ivory with a scalloped deco pattern in the middle: her mulberry faces, big.

mats.name: Wren
mats.why: A dark lagoon center inside a mulberry scalloped frame, with a plum paisley border. Her back color plus her faces' second color, like it was made for her.

mats.name: Ruby
mats.why: A sage center inside a dark floral border of berry, rose and gold. It ranked near the top of the Lagoon color pull in October, and the berry blooms pick up her crak frames.

mats.name: Caroline in Peacock
mats.why: A peacock teal center inside a frame of berry and magenta blooms. Both of her colors at full strength.

mats.name: Gilded Peacock
mats.why: Art deco on art deco: gold fan lines and peacock feathers on deep teal, with an ivory center like her faces.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Lagoon)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's own Lagoon Deco Dragon, made for these tiles: the same dragons, peacock feathers and deco lines, tone on tone. The Mulberry racks bring her second color.

mats.name: Deco Neoprene
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's Deco Neoprene mat (one colorway, deep teal with gold deco fans in the corners): designed to go with the Deco tiles.

mats.name: Peony Sociale Premium
mats.why: Deep teal medallions with hot pink peonies. Teal for the backs, berry pink for the craks.

mats.name: Spring Blooms Premium
mats.why: A lagoon-teal center framed in plum and gold flowers: the backs, the crak frames and the gold palm all at once.

mats.name: Year of the Snake
mats.why: Lagoon-blue ground with a pink frame and pink snakes; the sage center keeps it soft.

mats.name: Ocean Florals
mats.why: A dark teal center ringed in coral, rose and blue blooms, close to her rose crak frames.

mats.name: Plum Panda Premium
mats.why: Teal-green with a plum border and little pink flowers. The orange trim is the only stretch.

mats.name: SoHo
mats.why: Oh My Mahjong's deco sunburst in teal, blue and green. Retired, but a match if you already own it.

mats.name: Gatsby Glow
mats.why: Deco fans and a gold sunburst, from the same era as the tiles. The blue-teal fans carry the backs; the rust sun is the one wild card.

mats.name: Gatsby's Feathered Affair
mats.why: An art deco fan and herons in deep green and sage, with a deco line frame. Same era as the tiles; the deep green picks up her dragon and lion.

mats.name: Midnight Peacock
mats.why: Deep teal-green with gold palms, a quiet echo of the gold palm on every back.

mats.name: Crane & Moon
mats.why: Deep teal with a gold moon, cranes and coral flowers. The crane is a twin of her 1 Bam.

mats.name: Garden Party – Mulberry
mats.why: A berry center with a teal edge and lilac scallops. The tiles bring the teal, the mat brings the berry.

mats.name: Hawthorne
mats.why: A plum center inside navy and gold. Rich and dark, so her mulberry crak frames come forward.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Indigo)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's navy Deco Dragon. It matches her navy dots and numbers, and the dragons match hers.

mats.name: East Meets West – Magenta
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's solid magenta: her berry, turned up. The tiles bring all the teal.

_nov08: Tiffany Nov 8 10:11am edits: removed Petals After Dark, Crown Jewels, Royal Peacock, Imperial Peacock, Imperial Koi Pond, Indigo Reef, Teal Tapestry, Community Joy, Purple & Aqua Marble; added Deco Dragon (Lagoon), Deco Neoprene, Gatsby's Feathered Affair, OMM Jade, Britt Mills Ruby, East Meets West Magenta; Eden, Viola, Pretty in Plum into the top 10; TNT recs (config/tnt-recs.json deco-lagoon) lead the album, labelled 'TNT rec · mat · brand'. Reba stays the first non-TNT card; Deco Dragon (Mulberry) #8 (sister mat never #1).
